_help: fleet script for terrain 6 (English Channel): task groups the room scheduler raises while pilots are in the arena.
group: name, camp (0 US 1 GB 2 SU 3 GE 4 JP), flagship (carrier|battle|cruiser|cargo|uboat or a class id), escorts [..],
formation ring|column|line, spacing m, spawn [x,y] (default: first patrol point), heading deg, speed m/s,
patrol [[x,y],..] (loop true = closed circuit, false = there and back once), respawn_min, enabled.
The arena setting "Naval task groups" on the web TC tab overrides this file. Console: navy script|spawn|list|del|reload.
